An '''unidentified ''Turtle Tanker''''' was owned by a [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Unidentified Sakiyan cargo hauler/Legends|cargo hauler]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] used the ship to escape from [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]] and get to the planet [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]] in order to rescue his brother [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and return him to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Following this the ship was taken to Raydonia, during which time [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] found a surprising ally in [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] when they fought Savage Opress and Darth Maul in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] known as the [[Skirmish above Raydonia/Legends|Skirmish above Raydonia]] aboard the Turtle Tanker. Obi-Wan and Ventress escaped via the Tanker's escape pod cockpit, after which the ship was piloted by the brothers to [[Orto Norwe]] and abandoned.
